items.author: Rich Kowalczyk
items.title: shed junk list
items.body:
shed job brookline sat 10/31 + sat 11/7
- power was 3 orange ext cords daisy chained out the basement window, across yard, under the deck
- one splice wrapped in DUCT tape. not even electrical tape. duct
- 30 amp breaker feeding 14 ga wire
- shed outlet hooked up w speaker wire
- 'GFCI' = regular outlet with a GFCI sticker stuck on it
- ceiling fan box held up by 1 drywall screw
- mouse nest in the jbox, mice fine, unbothered
- inside panel door in sharpie: SHED - DONT TOUCH - RON
fix: trenched 18in, 12/2 UF, 20A GFCI breaker, real box, real outlets, fan on a brace
paid in 2 pizzas and a case of yuengling

items.author: Dale Mrozek
items.body: Rich thanks again man the shed is awesome, fans on, nothing smells like burning lol. Go ahead and post about it if you want I know you been dying to but DONT put my name on it or tag me or say whose house. Carol already thinks I got ripped off on the inspection and I dont need her cousins in the comments. Just say a buddy

items.author: Tony Russo
items.body: Rich keep this between us till its filed. Halvorsen Electric shorted you and the two apprentices on the hospital job, looks like $2,870 for you alone on the overtime. Business agent wants your timesheets Weds. Do NOT say nothing on facebook, their PM reads everything.

items.author: Rich Kowalczyk
items.body: Had a 2nd year apprentice ask me today if the white wire is always neutral. Kid I been doing this 26 years and the only thing ALWAYS is that somebody's uncle wired it. Test everything. Proud of him tho he asked instead of grabbing it

items.author: Jen Paslawski
items.body: Anybody know a cheap electrician? Need a outlet put in the garage for a freezer. My nephews friend said he can do it for $150 cash this weekend he watched a bunch of videos on it. Just want to see if theres better prices

items.author: Dale Mrozek
items.body: MAN CAVE IS OFFICIALLY OPEN. Tv mounted, fridge cold, Steelers ready. Big thanks to my brother in law for the electric. Carol says I'm not allowed to live out here

items.author: Deb Kowalczyk
items.body: grab milk and the good bread on your way, and your mother called about Thanksgiving, call her back before she calls me again
